The API payload rights scanner ensures that only verified inputs enter the pipeline, preventing unauthorized or malformed data from triggering downstream actions. The local review queue persistence simulator enforces a strict separation between draft and live states, ensuring that no action is taken until explicit approval. Finally, the shadow metric validation framework allows for offline evaluation of new metrics without risking live performance. The failure mode occurs when any of these assumptions are violated, leading to either unauthorized access, premature activation, or invalid metric influence.
